- The constant `LatestSchemaFileName = "LATEST.sql"` is defined with the comment "This file is used to initialize fresh installations with the current schema" (`store/migrator.go:54-56`).
- The corresponding file for the SQLite driver exists at `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql`, alongside the versioned incremental migration folders (e.g. `store/migration/sqlite/0.30/`) used only for upgrading existing installations.
